mapper.select: SELECT COALESCE(SUM(${code}), 0) AS qty, sku_no, warehouse_id FROM ${tableName} WHERE is_deleted = FALSE GROUP BY sku_no, warehouse_id

select t1.ID AS sourceId, t1.code AS sourceCode, 'fbaShipment' AS sourceType, t1.delivery_status AS status, t2.declare_qty AS declareQty, t2.delivery_qty AS deliveryQty, t2.receive_qty AS receiveQty, t2.delivery_qty - t2.receive_qty AS inTransitQty, #{result.replenishmentDetail.calcVersion} AS calcVersion from ${tableName} t1 INNER JOIN ${tableDetailName} t2 on t2.is_deleted = false and t2.main_id = t1.id where t1.is_deleted = false and t2.sku_id = #{result.replenishment.skuId} and t1.shop_id = #{result.replenishment.shopId} and (t2.delivery_qty - t2.receive_qty) > 0 and t1.delivery_status = 'shipped'

select t1.id as sourceId, t1.code as sourceCode, 'firstMileDelivery' as sourceType, t1.approve_status as status, t1.approve_time as deliveryDate, t2.delivery_qty as deliveryQty, COALESCE( (SELECT SUM (t4.receive_qty) FROM ${shipmentName} t3 INNER JOIN ${shipmentDetailName} t4 ON t4.is_deleted = FALSE AND t4.main_id = t3.id AND t3.code = t2.fba_shipment_code AND t4.sku_id = #{result.replenishment.skuId}), 0) AS receiveQty, (t2.delivery_qty - COALESCE( (SELECT SUM (t4.receive_qty) FROM ${shipmentName} t3 INNER JOIN ${shipmentDetailName} t4 ON t4.is_deleted = FALSE AND t4.main_id = t3.id AND t3.code = t2.fba_shipment_code AND t4.sku_id = #{result.replenishment.skuId}), 0)) as inTransitQty, #{result.replenishmentDetail.calcVersion} as calcVersion from ${tableName} t1 INNER JOIN ${tableDetailName} t2 on t2.is_deleted = false and t2.main_id = t1.id where t1.is_deleted = false and t2.sku_id = #{result.replenishment.skuId} and t1.shop_id = #{result.replenishment.shopId} and t1.approve_status = 'approve' and (t2.delivery_qty - COALESCE( (SELECT SUM (t4.receive_qty) FROM ${shipmentName} t3 INNER JOIN ${shipmentDetailName} t4 ON t4.is_deleted = FALSE AND t4.main_id = t3.id AND t3.code = t2.fba_shipment_code AND t4.sku_id = #{result.replenishment.skuId}), 0)) > 0

select t1.id,t1.approve_time,t2.fba_shipment_code from ${tableName} t1 INNER JOIN ${tableDetailName} t2 on t2.is_deleted = false and t2.main_id = t1.id where t1.is_deleted = false and t2.fba_shipment_code in
#{code}
SELECT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM information_schema.tables WHERE table_name = #{tableName} AND table_schema = 'public')
SELECT sku_id, warehouse_code, COALESCE(sum(${code}), 0) AS qty FROM ${tableName} WHERE is_deleted = FALSE GROUP BY warehouse_code, sku_id

select parp.purchase_application_detail_id, parp.purchase_application_id, parp.purchase_order_detail_id, parp.purchase_order_id, COALESCE(pod.purchase_qty,0) as purchaseQty from ${otherTableName} parp left join ${tableName} po on parp.purchase_order_id = po.id and po.is_deleted = false and po.invalid_status = false left join ${tableDetailName} pod on parp.purchase_order_detail_id = pod.id and po.id = pod.purchase_order_id and pod.is_deleted = false where parp.is_deleted = false and parp.purchase_application_detail_id in
#{item}

select id, create_time, update_time, create_user_name, create_user_id, update_user_name, update_user_id, version, is_deleted, fba_shipment_id, warehouse_id, asin, msku, fn_sku, sku_no, product_name, delivery_channels, fbm_fulfillable_qty, inbound_working_qty, inbound_shipped_qty, inbound_receiving_qty, fulfillable_qty, reserved_qty, researching_qty, unsellable_qty, inventory_age, warehouse_name, reserved_transfers_qty, reserved_processing_qty, reserved_order_qty, inventory_age_0_to_30_days, inventory_age_31_to_60_days, inventory_age_61_to_90_days, inventory_age_91_to_180_days, inventory_age_181_to_270_days, inventory_age_271_to_365_days, inventory_age_365_plus_days, data_start_time, data_end_time from ${tableName} where is_deleted = false

SELECT warehouseId, source_type, source_code, qty, sourceId, estimatedPutAwayDate FROM (SELECT MAX (warehouse_id) AS warehouseId, MAX(source_type) AS source_type, MAX(source_code) AS source_code, SUM(qty) AS qty, MAX(bill_date) AS estimatedPutAwayDate, MAX(source_id) AS sourceId FROM (select tf.warehouse_id, tf.warehouse_name, tf.bill_date, tf.sku_id, tf.sku_no, tf.qty, tf.source_id, case when tf.source_type in ('instockForcast', 'warehouseReceive', 'purchaseStockIn', 'purchaseReturnOrder') then 'purchaseInTransit' when tf.source_type in ('transferOut', 'transferIn') then 'transferInTransit' else '' end as source_type, case
when tf.source_type = 'instockForcast' then inv.purchase_order_code when tf.source_type = 'warehouseReceive' then wr.purchase_order_code when tf.source_type = 'purchaseStockIn' then po.purchase_order_code when tf.source_type = 'purchaseReturnOrder' then pr.purchase_order_code
when tf.source_type = 'transferOut' then tfo.code when tf.source_type = 'transferIn' then tfi.source_code
else '' end as source_code from ${transactionFlow} tf
left join ${instockForcast} inv on inv.id = tf.source_id and tf.source_type = 'instockForcast' left join ${poReceive} wr on wr.id = tf.source_id and tf.source_type = 'warehouseReceive' left join ${poInstock} po on po.id = tf.source_id and tf.source_type = 'purchaseStockIn' left join ${poReturn} pr on pr.id = tf.source_id and tf.source_type = 'purchaseReturnOrder'
left join ${transferOut} tfo on tfo.id = tf.source_id and tf.source_type = 'transferOut' left join ${transferIn} tfi on tfi.id = tf.source_id and tf.source_type = 'transferIn'
where tf.is_deleted = 'f' and tf.dict_inventory_status = 'inTransit' and tf.source_type in ('instockForcast', 'warehouseReceive', 'purchaseStockIn', 'purchaseReturnOrder', 'transferOut', 'transferIn') and tf.sku_id = #{skuId} and tf.warehouse_id in
#{item}
) m group by source_type, source_code order by estimatedPutAwayDate desc) t where t.qty > 0

select id, create_time, update_time, create_user_name, create_user_id, update_user_name, update_user_id, version, is_deleted, warehouse_code, dict_platform, name, platform_sku, platform_sku_name, product_name, sku_no, sku_id, deliver_onway_qty, pending_qty, sellable_qty, unsellable_qty, reserved_qty, onway_qty, lack_qty, frozen_qty, shipped_qty, download_time from ${tableName} where is_deleted = false

select id, create_time, update_time, create_user_name, create_user_id, update_user_name, update_user_id, version, is_deleted, org_id, warehouse_id, warehouse_location, sku_id, sku_no, dict_inventory_status, qty from ${tableName} where is_deleted = false

select id, create_time, update_time, create_user_name, create_user_id, update_user_name, update_user_id, version, is_deleted, warehouse_id, virtual_warehouse_id, sku_id, sku_no, dict_inventory_status, qty from ${tableName} where is_deleted = false

SELECT ds.id AS sourceId, ds.code AS sourceCode, ds.status AS status, ds.suggest_delivery_qty AS qty, ds.estimate_sales_date AS estimateSalesDate FROM ${tableName} ds WHERE ds.shop_id = #{result.replenishment.shopId} AND ds.sku_id = #{result.replenishment.skuId} AND ds.invalid_status = false
AND ds.status = 'finish' AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM ${otherTableDetailName} wdpd left join ${otherTableName} wdp on wdp.id = wdpd.main_id and wdp.is_deleted = false and wdpd.is_deleted = false WHERE wdpd.source_json IS NOT NULL AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM jsonb_array_elements(wdpd.source_json) AS elem WHERE elem ->> 'sourceId' = ds.id::text )
AND ds.status IN
#{code}
AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM ${otherTableDetailName} wdpd left join ${otherTableName} wdp on wdp.id = wdpd.main_id and wdp.is_deleted = false and wdpd.is_deleted = false WHERE wdpd.source_json->>'id' = ds.id::text )
AND ds.status IN
#{code}

select n.warehouse_id AS warehouseId, n.org_id AS orgId, n.sku_id AS skuId, n.sku_no AS skuNo, n.purchase_qty AS purchaseQty, n.transfer_qty AS transferQty, n.transport_qty AS transportQty from ( select m.warehouse_id,m.org_id,m.sku_id,m.sku_no, case when m.purchase_qty < 0 then 0 else m.purchase_qty end as purchase_qty, case when m.transfer_qty < 0 then 0 else m.transfer_qty end as transfer_qty, purchase_qty + transfer_qty as transport_qty from ( select tf.warehouse_id, tf.sku_id, max(tf.org_id) as org_id, max(tf.sku_no) as sku_no , sum(case when tf.dict_biz_type in ('21','01','03','04','25','27','28') and tf.dict_inventory_status = 'inTransit' then tf.qty else 0 end) as purchase_qty, sum(case when tf.dict_biz_type in ('08','09') and tf.dict_inventory_status = 'inTransit' then tf.qty else 0 end) as transfer_qty from ${tableName} tf group by tf.warehouse_id, tf.sku_id ) m ) n where n.transport_qty > 0
